title: The Effect of Bariatric Surgery on Spermatogenesis
brief_summary: Little is known about the effects of weight loss surgery on male reproductive health. This study will investigate the effect of bariatric surgery on male infertility by evaluating sexual health, blood hormone levels, and semen parameters before and after roux-en-y bariatric surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Men aged 18-55
* Undergoing Roux-en-Y bariatric surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of undescended testes
* Prior scrotal surgery
* Known karyotypic abnormalities
study_population: Men between the ages of 18 and 50 scheduled for bariatric surgery who meet the above enrollment criteria will be offered enrollment in the study at the time of their preoperative clinic visit.
